hold_text: One human read, then merge. The diff edits .github/workflows/board-post.yml, which pr-landing-guard classifies as landing machinery, so R12 applies: a change to the machinery must not be merged by that machinery unread, because the change and its own approval would be the same act. What needs reading is one claim -- that the workflow edit is COMMENT LINES ONLY. It is verifiable in one command rather than by reading the diff: `git diff -U0 .github/workflows/board-post.yml | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)' | grep -vE '^[+-]\s*#'` returns nothing. The YAML also parses. No behaviour changes; the relay's steps, triggers and exit codes are untouched.
why: Tier-1 by every path in the diff -- docs and .github only; no runtime, no order path, no strategy config, no risk caps, no live-VM file, no service unit. The tier is not the objection and never was; this is held on R12 alone. NOTE, because the first version of this file asserted the opposite and was wrong: it claimed `R12 does not apply: board-post.yml is the coordination-board relay, not the landing machinery`. The guard disagrees and the guard is authoritative about its own scope -- field beats comment. Recorded here rather than silently overwritten so the next session does not re-derive the same wrong boundary. Contents: (1) docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json, one row appended through scripts/ops/backlog_append.py so the file's exact serialisation round-trips (10 insertions, 0 deletions -- no reformat churn, so no pre-existing row is re-attributed to this PR); (2) .github/workflows/board-post.yml, correcting a stale header sentence that made a SUCCESSFUL board post read as a failed one.
